text.autoconfig.simplearrows.title: Simple Arrows
text.autoconfig.simplearrows.option.silv:
Extra damage of a silver arrow against undead mobs (zombies, skeletons, ...). 0 = like a normal arrow. Range 0 to 6.
Default: 3.
text.autoconfig.simplearrows.option.ligh:
A Light Arrow stuck in a block lights the air in front of it (level 15) until the arrow despawns or is picked up. Off = a plain arrow.
Default: on.
+1.5 damage, flies straight for the first second
Shatters on impact: 1 damage to everything close by
Releases a wind burst on impact
jei.simplearrows.note.fletching: One tip, one shaft, one fletching: a crafted arrow
jei.simplearrows.info.crafted_arrow: Made at the Fletching Table: one tip, one shaft and one fletching give 4 arrows. The tip sets the damage, shaft and fletching change the flight. Infinity only saves vanilla arrows.
jei.simplearrows.info.light_arrow: Stuck in a block, it lights the air in front of it like a torch (light level 15). The light goes with the arrow: when it despawns, is picked up or falls out.
jei.simplearrows.info.silver_arrow: Deals %s extra damage to undead (zombies, skeletons, ...). Crafted from a Simple Ores silver nugget, a stick and a feather; without Simple Ores there is no recipe.
simplearrows.guide.page.1.title: Simple Arrows
simplearrows.guide.page.1: Arrows: the Fletching Table builds four arrows from a tip, a shaft and a fletching, optionally with a potion; the Light Arrow lights the spot where it sticks, the Silver Arrow hits undead harder.
simplearrows.guide.page.2.title: Light Arrow
simplearrows.guide.page.2: An arrow that lights the spot where it sticks - until it despawns like any arrow.
simplearrows.guide.page.3.title: Silver Arrow
simplearrows.guide.page.3: An arrow with a silver head that hits the undead harder (moved here from Simple Ores on 03.11.2026).
simplearrows.guide.page.4.title: Fletching Table
simplearrows.guide.page.4: Arrows from the Fletching Table: one tip, one shaft and one fletching make 4 arrows. Right-click the vanilla Fletching Table to open it.
simplearrows.guide.page.5.title: Commands
simplearrows.guide.page.6.title: Settings
simplearrows.guide.page.6: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
